# Checkbox

A native checkbox, kept focusable under whatever you draw over it.

In `library/components/checkbox/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

**Root:** `.ac-choice`, `.ac-group`

## ARIA

- **the input** — `type=checkbox`
- **the label** — `for`
- **a group's running count** — `role=status`

## Keyboard

- `Space` — toggles
- `Tab` — one stop per box — unlike radios, the arrows do nothing

**States:** checked, indeterminate, disabled, invalid

## Goes wrong when

- the drawn box replacing the input instead of sitting over it, so nothing is focusable
- display:none or visibility:hidden on the real input, which removes keyboard access
- indeterminate written as an attribute — it exists only as a JS property
- related boxes with no fieldset and legend, so the question is never announced

**API:** `AC.createCheckbox(root, options) -> { state, refresh, element, destroy }`

WCAG 1.3.1 1.4.1 2.1.1 2.4.7 2.5.8 3.3.1 4.1.2 4.1.3 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/checkbox/) · see also `switch`, `radio-group`, `fieldset-group`
